00044 :   UGenInternal(NumInputs),

00059 void DustUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00060 {
00061     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00062     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00063     float currentDensity = *(inputs[Density].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00064     
00065     unsigned long s1, s2, s3;
00066     random.get(s1, s2, s3);
00067     
00068     if (currentDensity != prevDensity) {
00069         threshold = currentDensity * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate();
00070         scale  = threshold > 0.f ? 1.f / threshold : 0.f;
00071     }
00072     
00073     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00074     {
00075         float value = Ran088::nextFloat(s1, s2, s3);
00076         if(value < threshold)
00077             *outputSamples++ = value * scale;
00078         else
00079             *outputSamples++ = 0.f;
00080     }
00081     
00082     prevDensity = currentDensity;
00083     random.set(s1, s2, s3);
00084 }

00096 void Dust2UGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
